recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩群共五個大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，其中數個細胞核內有邊界清楚的淡染凹陷，像杯口或魚嘴（cup-like nuclear invagination）；背景還有塗抹破裂的細胞殘骸。杯狀核母細胞是 NPM1 合併 FLT3-ITD 突變 AML 的形態線索。
features: Two small groups of large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Pale, well-defined cup-like (fish-mouth) nuclear invaginations in several blasts
Scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Elongated smudged/crushed cell remnant in the center of the field
Red cells with refractile drying artifact; phone-camera photograph limits nucleolar detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows two groups of large blasts with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm, several of which contain well-defined pale cup-like nuclear invaginations. Auer rods are not seen, and a smudged cell remnant is present. Red cells show refractile drying artifact, and the photograph limits assessment of nucleoli. In the setting of marked leukocytosis with about 85% circulating blasts, the findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia, raising the possibility of NPM1-mutated AML with FLT3-ITD; flow cytometry, cytogenetics and molecular testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed or butterfly nuclei, may show Auer rod bundles, and carry PML::RARA, whereas cup-like blasts have round nuclei with a single indentation.
Promonocytes have delicately folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant gray cytoplasm and vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase-positive.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and TdT-positive, whereas cup-like AML is typically CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative with MPO positivity.
